lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Distinct grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters organized into roughly five vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with a higher density of local maxima in the dorsal-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of spots, forming high-contrast anchor nodes where the bands overlap with the circular blobs.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible running horizontally along the mid-flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with higher intensity on the dorsal side and deep shadowing immediately below the ridge line.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible area of the first dorsal fin exhibits several discrete, high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily along the lower two-thirds of the fin's lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple remoras (Echeneidae) are visible trailing the host, specifically one attached near the posterior base of the left pectoral fin and two others swimming ventrally.
